plain: A shared rule in some part of life about who may share what information with whom, and when.
eli5: The unwritten rule that what you tell the school nurse stays with the nurse.
technical: In contextual integrity, a rule about personal information moving between parties (who may send what, about whom, to whom, under what transmission principle) within a social context; whether a norm exists is an empirical question and whether it is legitimate a separate one, and benchmarks such as CIMemories approximate norms with labels that are aggregated judgments, not norms themselves; unrelated to vector norm.
